name_ja: 大通公園 朝ラン（西1〜西12丁目往復 約3km）
name_en: Morning run: Odori Park end to end (about 3 km)
address: 札幌市中央区大通西1丁目〜西12丁目
highlight_en: Odori Park runs about 1.5 km from Nishi 1-chome (TV Tower) to Nishi 12-chome through the city centre.
notes: Start: TV Tower (Odori Nishi 1). Out and back to Nishi 12 is about 3 km. Park length is official; loop distance is our estimate. Paths are snow-covered Dec-Mar and winter events (White Illumination, Snow Festival) take space; mid-May has lilacs. No official photo found above 220 px.

name_ja: 中島公園〜豊平川河川敷 朝ラン（約5km）
name_en: Morning run: Nakajima Park and Toyohira riverside (about 5 km)
address: 札幌市中央区中島公園1
highlight_en: Riverside paths between Horohira Bridge and Toyohira Bridge run along the Toyohira River, a short walk from Nakajima Park.
notes: Start: Nakajima-koen Station. Loop the park (about 2 km), go to the river at Horohira Bridge (about 500 m), run downstream to Toyohira Bridge (about 1.9 km by river km posts) and return. Distances from MLIT river km posts and runner blogs, not an official course. Riverside paths are not cleared in winter; in March use the park only. Park official page: https://www.sapporo-park.or.jp/nakajima/

name_ja: 北海道大学キャンパス 朝ラン（メインストリート約1.2km／外周約6km）
name_en: Morning run: Hokkaido University campus (1.2 km main street, about 6 km outer loop)
address: 札幌市北区北8条西5丁目
highlight_en: Campus is a 7 min walk from Sapporo Station north exit and 4 min from Kita-12-jo Station.
notes: Start: main gate near Sapporo Station north exit. Main street with ginkgo rows is about 1-1.2 km straight; outer loop 6.2 km (Runtrip course https://runtrip.jp/courses/hokkaido/1102). Distances from runner sites. Watch for bicycles and morning club practice. Snow-packed in winter. Address is the university's main address.

name_ja: 白石こころーど 朝ラン（札幌コンベンションセンター起点 7.2km）
name_en: Morning run: Shiroishi Kokoro-do path from Sapporo Convention Center (7.2 km section)
address: 札幌市白石区東札幌6条1丁目
highlight_en: Car-free path on the old JNR Chitose Line that starts at Sapporo Convention Center; crossings are underpasses, so no traffic lights.
notes: Start: Sapporo Convention Center (Higashi-Sapporo 6-jo 1). 7.2 km to Niji-no-Hashi bridge; turn back any time (e.g. 3 km out and back). Cherry trees at Mansei Park late April to early May. Not cleared of snow in winter (blog report), so not for March. Station walk time is our estimate.

name_ja: 森彦 本店
address: 札幌市中央区南2条西26丁目2-18
price_variants: [{"name": "森の雫（本店限定ブレンド）", "price_jpy": 1430}, {"name": "季節のコーヒー", "price_jpy": 1210}, {"name": "水出しコーヒー", "price_jpy": 1320}, {"name": "ガトーフロマージュ", "price_jpy": 726}]
highlight_en: Café in a renovated post-war wooden house with a wood stove; signature deep-roast blend 'Mori no Shizuku'.
notes: No reservations. Menu prices not online. Exit 4 of Maruyama-koen Station. Prices (tax included, Feb 2026 visit) from https://satumeshi.com/cafe/15227/; that page gives hours 9:00-20:00 (L.O. 19:00), differing from the hours above.

name_ja: 徳光珈琲 大通店
address: 札幌市中央区大通西3丁目 大通ビッセ2F
highlight_en: Specialty roaster from Ishikari; selects green beans and hand-picks defects before roasting. Odori store is directly connected to Odori Station.
notes: Price on site not listed; a 2025 review says drip coffee 650 yen, refill 350 yen (https://umaten.jp/hokkaido/tokumitsu-coffee-odori-sapporo-cafe-review-2025/). Also Maruyama store (Odori Nishi 25, closed 2nd/4th Sun).

name_ja: 丸美珈琲店 大通本店
address: 札幌市中央区南1条西1丁目2 松崎ビル1F
price_variants: [{"name": "ドリップコーヒー", "price_jpy": 660}, {"name": "アイスコーヒー", "price_jpy": 715}, {"name": "カフェラテ", "price_jpy": 715}, {"name": "季節のワッフル", "price_jpy": 935}]
highlight_en: Specialty coffee shop run by roaster and coffee taster Goto, who buys seasonal coffee at origin.
notes: Store details from a 2023 listing article; official site https://www.marumi-coffee.com/ is the online shop and did not show store hours. Check hours before demo. Prices (drip from 660) from https://www.mapple.net/spot/1017961/; Marumi raised prices Apr 2025 so check in store (one review says 770).

name_ja: 二条市場 海鮮ランチ＆札幌歴史ウォーキングツアー
name_en: Authentic Sapporo: Nijo Market seafood lunch and local history tour
address: 札幌市中央区北1条西2丁目（時計台集合）
highlight_en: Small-group walk from the Clock Tower past City Hall, the TV Tower and the Sosei River, ending with a sushi or donburi lunch at Nijo Market.
notes: Listed at about US$61-64 per person (price_jpy is a rough conversion; check). Includes guide, TV Tower admission and lunch. Operator 株式会社エゾシカ旅行社, guide holds a 'KAPPO SAPPORO' board. Needs good weather; refund or rebook if cancelled. Viator blocks fetching (403); details from search results.

name_ja: 札幌ウォーキングツアー（H.I.S.）
name_en: Sapporo Walking Tour (H.I.S. Tourist Info Center)
address: 札幌駅周辺（集合）
cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 24 h before
highlight_en: Three-hour English walking tour from Sapporo Station including TV Tower admission and a sweets stop; in snow the route moves underground.
notes: Price shown as from US$58 (price_jpy is a rough conversion). Exact meeting spot and start time not found. Listing only; no official operator page. Alternative: private English guide 5,000 yen per guide for up to 10 (https://sites.google.com/view/sapporo-sightseeing-guide/sapporo-walking-tours-with-local-english-guide).

name_ja: 旭山記念公園 スノーシュートレッキング（半日・送迎付き）
name_en: Snowshoe trek in Asahiyama Memorial Park (half day, hotel pickup)
address: 札幌市中央区界川4丁目（旭山記念公園）
cancellation_policy: 50% day before, 100% on the day; free if cancelled for weather
highlight_en: Guided snowshoe walk in a hillside park about 20 minutes by car from central Sapporo, with hotel pickup.
notes: Operator Great Adventure. Book by email hokkaido.ga@gmail.com or tel 011-788-6251. Includes guide, snowshoes, insurance, pickup. Season months not stated ('snow season'); 2026-27 dates not posted. Language not stated. Park address from park site https://www.sapporo-park.or.jp/asahiyama/.

name_ja: 二条市場
address: 札幌市中央区南3条東1丁目・2丁目
highlight_en: City-centre fish market by the Sosei River dating to the early Meiji era, with seafood bowl restaurants.
notes: Hours from Hokkaido Love (visit-hokkaido.jp/spot/detail_10002.html); other sources say to 18:00 and restaurants 6:00-21:00. Odori Station exit 34 also about 5 min. No parking. Market warns of fake phone sales calls.

name_ja: 札幌場外市場
address: 札幌市中央区北11条西21丁目〜23丁目
highlight_en: Market street next to Sapporo Central Wholesale Market, open every day from 6:00 for seafood breakfast and shopping.
notes: Hours from official FAQ. JR Soen Station about 9 min walk. Some eateries closed Wednesdays. Free parking about 100. Images only 660x260.

name_ja: 苗穂駅前温泉 蔵ノ湯
address: 札幌市中央区北2条東13丁目25-1
highlight_en: Natural hot spring at public-bath price one stop from Sapporo Station, with a cave-style open-air bath and a 94 C sauna.
notes: Adult 550 yen. Restaurant, laundry, massage on site. Promotes itself as a run station for Toyohira riverside runs. Free parking about 200.

name_ja: すすきの天然温泉 湯香郷（ジャスマックプラザ）
name_en: Susukino natural hot spring Tokakyo (Jasmac Plaza)
address: 札幌市中央区南7条西3丁目 ジャスマックプラザ
highlight_en: Hot spring from its own 800 m deep source in Susukino, with a granite main bath and a hinoki open-air bath; towel and yukata included.
notes: No official spa page found; hours and prices from listing sites, which disagree slightly. Tel 011-513-8107. No entry with tattoos or when drunk. Hotel site: https://www.jasmacplaza.jp/

name_ja: 美月桜 茶道体験
address: 札幌市中央区南2条西5丁目23-1 狸小路大王ビル6F
highlight_en: Matcha and Japanese sweets with a tea ceremony teacher in the annex tea room of a kimono rental shop on Tanukikoji.
notes: 30-40 min; first-time trial only. Kimono rental +3,300 yen. Tel 011-596-9881. English site exists; staff English not stated. Station walk time not stated. No photos on page.

name_ja: 札幌市アイヌ文化交流センター（サッポロピㇼカコタン）
name_en: Sapporo Ainu Culture Promotion Center (Sapporo Pirka Kotan)
address: 札幌市南区小金湯27
days_closed: Mon, holidays, last Tue of month
highlight_en: About 300 Ainu garments and tools on display that visitors can handle; free craft and costume corner (about 30 min, no booking).
notes: Exhibition room 350 yen; entry free. Craft corner 10:00-12:00, 13:00-16:00, from mid-April (2026 season started 4/14), so likely not in March. Far from centre: about 40 min by car from Sapporo Station (Jozankei direction); allow half a day with travel. Fees and closures from search summaries of city/tourism pages.

name_ja: 千歳鶴 酒ミュージアム
address: 札幌市中央区南3条東5丁目2
highlight_en: Museum shop of Sapporo's own sake brewery with brewing water and sake tastings, brewery-only sake and sake-lees soft serve.
notes: Free entry. Exit 9 of Bus Center-mae Station. Whether tastings are paid is not stated. age_min 20 applies to alcohol tasting only. Brewery tour by booking mentioned on other sites. Tel 011-221-7570.

name_ja: サッポロビール博物館 試飲付きガイドツアー
name_en: Sapporo Beer Museum guided tour with tasting
address: 札幌市東区北7条東9丁目1-1
price_variants: [{"name": "self-guided entry with audio guide", "price_jpy": 1000}, {"name": "guided tour with 2 tastings", "price_jpy": 2000}, {"name": "THE PERFECT TOUR (monthly, 70 min, 20+)", "price_jpy": 3000}]
highlight_en: Museum of Sapporo beer history since the Hokkaido colonisation project; Tasting Hall pours Black Label, Hokkaido-only Classic and Kaitakushi Beer brewed at the founding site.
notes: Guided tour Japanese only; self-guided audio guide in EN/KO/ZH. Hokkaido residents 700 yen entry / 1,700 tour. Paid Tasting Hall 11:00-18:30 (3-beer set 1,200 yen). JR Naebo north exit 8 min. Same entry as specialist.csv sample; keep one.

name_ja: 白い恋人パーク
address: 札幌市西区宮の沢2条2丁目11-36
price_variants: [{"name": "paid area entry", "price_jpy": 1200}, {"name": "+ make your own Shiroi Koibito (30-40 min)", "price_jpy": 2700}, {"name": "+ cookie decoration", "price_jpy": 3200}]
cancellation_policy: Online workshop bookings cancellable up to 2 days before
highlight_en: Sweets theme park by ISHIYA with the Shiroi Koibito factory, where visitors make and decorate their own Shiroi Koibito cookies.
notes: Workshop prices 900-2,000 yen on top of entry; hand-made course 1-12 people, online only. Factory renewal opened 7/30 (2026). Station walk time on access page is in an image (about 7 min from Miyanosawa, unverified). 'e-money and cards' accepted.

name_ja: 北海道大学総合博物館
address: 札幌市北区北10条西8丁目
highlight_en: Free university museum showing Hokkaido University's history from Sapporo Agricultural College (1876) and its research specimen collections.
notes: Good fit for academic attendees; combine with campus run/walk. Station walk time not on museum page. Image size not checked (site TLS chain broken for scripts).

name_ja: 札幌市時計台
address: 札幌市中央区北1条西2丁目
highlight_en: National Important Cultural Property: the 1878 drill hall of Sapporo Agricultural College; the hall upstairs recreates its ceremony room.
notes: Odori Station city-hall exit 5 min; JR Sapporo south exit 10 min. Clock winding demo 10:30 on some days. Open to 20:00 on first Monday of month. No large official photo found. Year 1878 is from memory; site says founded 148 years ago on 2026-10-16.

name_ja: 北海道開拓の村
address: 札幌市厚別区厚別町小野幌50-1
highlight_en: Open-air museum of relocated Meiji and Taisho buildings from across Hokkaido, with a horse-drawn tram.
notes: JR Hokkaido Bus from Shin-Sapporo bus terminal north bay 10, about 20 min. Shin-Sapporo is on the Tozai Line, same line as the convention center (Higashi-Sapporo). Horse tram timetable PDF on site; fare not checked.

name_ja: 札幌もいわ山ロープウェイ
address: 札幌市中央区伏見5丁目3-7
nearest_station: ロープウェイ入口（市電）
price_variants: [{"name": "ropeway + mini cable car return", "price_jpy": 2100}, {"name": "ropeway only return", "price_jpy": 1400}]
highlight_en: Ropeway and mini cable car to the summit of Mt. Moiwa for a 360-degree view over the city, best at night.
notes: 2027 maintenance closure 3/29-4/28 (fine for mid-March and mid-May). Free shuttle bus from tram stop Ropeway Iriguchi every 15 min (weekdays from 17:17). Web tickets via KKday; priority boarding ticket 17:00-21:00.

name_ja: さっぽろテレビ塔
address: 札幌市中央区大通西1丁目
highlight_en: Observation deck at the east end of Odori Park, looking down the full length of the park.
notes: Odori Station exit 27. Inspection closures in 2026 on 4/8 and 11/11; 2027 dates not yet posted besides 1/1.

name_ja: JRタワー展望室 タワー・スリーエイト
address: 札幌市中央区北5条西2丁目 JRタワー38F（札幌ステラプレイス6F入口）
highlight_en: 360-degree observatory 160 m above Sapporo Station, with a café.
notes: Entrance via Stellar Place Center elevator II to East 6F. Address from operator company page (same building); walk time our estimate. Online tickets linked from page.

name_ja: 大倉山展望台・札幌オリンピックミュージアム
name_en: Okurayama ski jump observatory and Sapporo Olympic Museum
address: 札幌市中央区宮の森1274
days_closed: Lift closed on jump competition and official practice days
highlight_en: Chairlift up the 1972 Olympic ski jump to a summit observatory over the city; the museum covers the Sapporo Winter Olympics.
notes: From Maruyama-koen Station exit 2, bus 'Kuramaru' about 15 min, or taxi about 10 min. Lift fare not in page text (likely in image); add it. Museum info: http://sapporo-olympicmuseum.jp/ . Lift stops in bad weather.

name_ja: さっぽろ羊ヶ丘展望台
address: 札幌市豊平区羊ケ丘1
highlight_en: Hilltop with the William S. Clark statue looking over the city and the Ishikari Plain.
notes: Bus about 10 min from Fukuzumi Station (Toho Line). Winter snow park 2027-01-08 to 03-07 (ends before mid-March). Official images found only as small nav thumbnails.

name_ja: 札幌市円山動物園
address: 札幌市中央区宮ケ丘3番地1
days_closed: 2nd and 4th Wed (Aug: 1st and 4th); Mon-Fri of the week with 2nd Wed in Apr and Nov
highlight_en: Sapporo's city zoo, next to Maruyama Park.
notes: Fee page https://www.city.sapporo.jp/zoo/s077/76124.html (adult 800, e-tickets from 2026-03). Check 2027 calendar for the April closure week; mid-May open.

name_ja: 札幌藻岩山スキー場 ナイタースキー
name_en: Sapporo Moiwa ski area night skiing
address: 札幌市南区藻岩下1991
highlight_en: City ski area on Mt. Moiwa with night skiing until 21:00.
notes: Season 2026-12-20 to 2027-03-14 (official), so only the first half of March. Lift prices from official ticket page https://sapporo-moiwa.jp/ticket/ (general fare; Hokkaido-resident fare lower; several seasonal price columns, lowest shown). Rental extra, not checked. Shuttle bus about 15 min from Makomanai-chugakko-mae stop near Makomanai Station. Snowboarding allowed from 2025 (listing).

name_ja: 滝野スノーワールド（国営滝野すずらん丘陵公園）
name_en: Takino Snow World (Takino Suzuran Hillside National Government Park)
address: 札幌市南区滝野247
price_variants: [{"name": "entry (winter)", "price_jpy": 0}, {"name": "cross-country ski set rental", "price_jpy": 1500}, {"name": "downhill ski set rental", "price_jpy": 3500}]
highlight_en: Winter park with tube sledding, snowshoe routes, cross-country ski courses from 5 km to 17 km and a frozen waterfall.
notes: Opens 2026-12-23; end date not posted (earlier seasons to 3/31, winter entry free per listings). Tube sleds and snowshoes lent free. Bus Ma106 from Makomanai Station about 32 min (Makomanai 18 min from Sapporo by subway), so half a day; over the 3 h short band.
